title: Voting with Random Proposers: Two Rounds May Suffice
abstract: arXiv:2410.20476v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces the Voting with Random Proposers (VRP) procedure to address the challenges of agenda manipulation in voting. In each round of VRP, a randomly selected proposer suggests an alternative that is voted on against the previous round's winner. In a framework with single-peaked preferences, we show that the VRP procedure guarantees that the Condorcet winner is implemented in a few rounds, and in just two rounds under sufficiently symmetric preference distributions, or whenever the initial status quo or the first proposer's type is not extreme. Under the equilibrium proposal strategy, sincere and sophisticated voting induce the same winner in every round. The results have applications for committee decisions, legislative decision-making, and the organization of citizens' assemblies and decentralized autonomous organizations.

translated_title: 随机提议者投票：两轮可能就够了
translated_abstract: 本文提出了随机提议者投票（VRP）程序，以应对投票中议程操纵的挑战。在VRP的每一轮中，随机选出的提议者提出一个备选方案，该方案与上一轮的获胜方案进行投票对决。在单峰偏好的分析框架下，我们证明VRP程序能保证在少数几轮内实现孔多塞赢家，并且在偏好分布足够对称的情况下，或当初始现状或第一位提议者的类型不极端时，仅需两轮即可实现。在均衡提议策略下，真诚投票和策略性投票在每一轮都会产生相同的赢家。这些结果对委员会决策、立法决策以及公民大会和去中心化自治组织的组织形式具有应用价值。
tldr: 本文提出随机提议者投票（VRP）程序以防止议程操纵，证明在单峰偏好下该程序能保证孔多塞赢家在少数几轮内胜出，且在偏好分布足够对称等条件下仅需两轮，同时真诚投票与策略性投票结果一致。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Voting with Random Proposers (VRP) procedure to prevent agenda manipulation, proving that under single-peaked preferences it guarantees the Condorcet winner in just a few rounds—and only two rounds when preference distributions are sufficiently symmetric—while sincere and sophisticated voting always yield the same winner.
